title: Guitar
time: 'Tuesday' — the first sleep after act2_metro_done (guitarNights); the shop's text, the Ready note and the MG Road stop follow from guitar_in_stock
player_goal: Buy the guitar; learn three chords.
design_goal: Reward bought with the salary (mid-game rewards every 30–60 min, engagement_guidelines): the wishlist from 1.6 pays off. Reveal: the first mini-game (a rhythm lane) — it is also Act 4's noise lure and a stress valve, so it is built as a reusable system, not a one-off. Relationship: Ananya hears a clip → met becomes warm. Progress: MG Road / Church Street becomes a pocket on the Purple Line.

cast.role: The 1.6 shop owner, behind his own counter now (he leaves Cubbon's pavement once guitar_in_stock). 'Tuesday. I said Tuesday and here you are.' Six-five, no bargaining; a pick and a chord chart thrown in.
Busker by the mural with an open case. ₹10 in the case → busker_tipped: he shows you the G shape (lesson 1 passes at 60% instead of 70%).

beats.what: The first sleep after the metro ride: the shop's text ('Tuesday. Spruce top kept aside. Six-five.'), the wishlist note turns to READY, the shop joins Contacts, and Maps offers METRO to MG Road · Church Street before your first visit (knownIf).

Metro to MG Road (or RIDE), up the station stairs onto Church Street — the new pocket: bookshop, café, the guitar shop between two pots, the mural, the busker, a 335-E stop home. Inside the shop the owner sells the guitar for ₹6,500 (spend(); 'Not today' leaves it till Saturday) and throws in the chord chart.

Home: the guitar now stands by the window wall of the flat. Step up to it → the rhythm lane (RhythmScene): chord chips slide to the strum line, E / Space / tap STRUM on the beat; 16 strums of G at 76 bpm, 70% to learn it. Any finished session uses up the night and eases stress (−10).
The next two nights: C (G–C at 84 bpm) and D (G–C–D–G at 92 bpm, three strums a bar). Already played tonight → 'Fingertips still sore. Tomorrow.'

After the third lesson: 'A ten-second clip?' Send it to Ananya (her state → warm; she answers 'That was almost a song') or keep it (Photos; she asks about the guitar later). Either way the clip is in Photos.
The guitar stays: a free strum any later night (−5 stress, once a night). Act 4 reads guitar_owned (noise lure, the base).

exits.note: METRO · ₹N between station pockets; knownIf guitar_in_stock opens it before the first visit
